nodes.statement: Fix one admitted actual PC+BDCC process token or overlapping family, interval, complete signature, selected target tau, commitment boundary, admissible intervention family, and fixed background.
nodes.scope: One target-relative actual application; a finite witness does not discharge actual admission.

nodes.statement: The application independently fixes the R190-style practical-centering and bearer-directed consequence-coupling conditions without treating the disabled R190 module as an established premise.
nodes.scope: Same actual target tau and episode; every route premise must be re-discharged in an application.

nodes.statement: WCU_tau records actual mutually exclusive route carriers received by a consumer but omits when and how they affect authorization.
OCCA_tau requires actual rival carriers, actual installed consumer use before commitment, and intervention-sensitive route authorization under fixed backgrounds.
nodes.scope: Same selected target, episode, carriers, consumer, timing boundary, intervention contract, and background.

nodes.statement: Post-hoc conflict consumption satisfies WCU but not OCCA, so carriers plus consumer use do not entail online authorization.
Deliberate online adjudication and a frozen reflex table can match every declared current OCCA field.
nodes.scope: Present-episode signature only; not complete real-world identity.

nodes.statement: LGRU_tau adds actual prior same-lineage conflict-driven revision, declared carrier continuation, and actual current use of the continued disposition.
nodes.scope: Restricted application of R173's actual-history interface; copied values do not substitute for occurrences.

nodes.statement: The frozen table matches the present-episode signature but differs under the history-expanded signature; copied memory does not recover the missing formation occurrence.
nodes.scope: Declared deliberate/frozen pair and explicit current versus historical signatures.

nodes.statement: An adaptive reflex controller satisfies both OCCA and LGRU, so their conjunction does not identify deliberateness, voluntary endorsement, felt trying, agency, ownership, or familiar mineness.
nodes.scope: Declared finite twin; no positive phenomenal classification.

nodes.statement: Actual application requires independent same-instance evidence for rival carriers, consumer, precommit timing, authorization sensitivity, intervention/background contract, and any claimed formation lineage.
nodes.scope: Actual application only; tests, reports, labels, or code do not discharge the conjunction.

nodes.statement: If all actual premises are independently discharged, OCCA and LGRU may characterize action organization inside experience under C1 while remaining unnecessary for basal experience and insufficient for any named self-feeling.
nodes.scope: Organization-level interpretation only; no scalar experience, subject count, unique owner, or current-system verdict.

rules.statement: Apply the actual carrier/consumer/timing/intervention authorization contract to one fixed PC+BDCC episode.
rules.binding: All fields concern one target, episode, boundary, consumer, and intervention background.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Rival routes are mutually exclusive authorization alternatives, not separate proofs.

rules.statement: Compare precommit and post-hoc consumer timing while retaining real rival carriers.
rules.binding: The post-hoc witness fixes target and carriers but moves consumer use across the commitment boundary.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: The cases are alternative rows, not simultaneous token properties.

rules.statement: Hold every current OCCA field fixed while varying only the declared formation/source label.
rules.binding: Paired alternative rows share the complete declared current signature.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A sufficiency counterexample, not a phenomenal classification.

rules.statement: Restrict R173 retained-history conditions to earlier conflict-driven authorization revision and current use.
rules.binding: Prior occurrence, lineage, continuing carrier, current consumer, and target must satisfy the inherited interface jointly.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Copied memory and actual earlier occurrence are distinct candidates.

rules.statement: Interpret independently grounded organization inside experience while preserving U1 and the adaptive-reflex nonidentification limit.
rules.binding: All actual carriers, consumers, times, lineage facts, target, and intervention premises concern the same admitted application.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No toy row, report, or test success substitutes for actual premise truth.

context_links.statement: LGRU is an action-authorization specialization of the established retained-history interface.
The adaptive-reflex case extends, but does not replace, the earlier reflex-twin limitation.
OCCA plus actual formation history still does not identify familiar mineness.
Online conflict or retained revision may structure selected experience but is not required for basal experience.
